Name: Hispanic Federation 2026 UPLift New York State
Area_of_Interest__c:
Hispanic Federation (HF) is issuing a Request for Proposals (RFP) to member agencies and allies for the
implementation of a targeted campaign to provide health access and literacy, economic empowerment
programming, and basic needs services to New York’s communities of color, particularly
bilingual/bicultural communities.
Documentation_Requirements__c:
- Must be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit or have a fiscal sponsor
- Must serve communities in New York State
- Must provide culturally and linguistically responsive services
- Programs must align with one or more priority areas:
1. Language access
2. Civic education
3. Workforce training
4. Educational advancement
- Must demonstrate community impact and organizational capacity
- Grant requests cannot exceed 30% of the organization's annual operating budget
- Must submit required organizational documents (IRS determination letter, budget, etc.)
- Programs should support underserved and/or Latino communities and improve socioeconomic outcomes.

Name: CCNSF
Area_of_Interest__c: Education, immigrant communities, workforce development, low-income families, youth empowerment, community services
Documentation_Requirements__c:
Eligibility Requirements:

• Must be registered in PASSPort.
• Must have 501(c)(3) status and at least two years as an incorporated nonprofit.
• Must be current with NYS Charities Bureau registration.
• Must be an NYC-based direct social service organization serving primarily 75%+ NYC residents.
• Must serve communities where 51%+ of the population are people of color.
• Must have demonstrated outreach to communities of color for ED/CEO and board recruitment.
• Operating budget must be at least $150,000 and no more than $3.5 million.
• Fiscal sponsors/conduits are not eligible.

Document checklist:

• Board of directors, officers, and affiliations.
• Current fiscal year agency budget.
• CHAR500 or proof of NYS Charities Bureau registration.
• Most recent Form 990.
• Most recent financial audit.
• Executive Director resume.
• Key program staff resumes.
• Consultant resumes/company profile if consultants are used.

Name: Banco Popular Foundation
Geographic_Scope__c: Puerto Rico, U.S Virgin Islands, and United States
Area_of_Interest__c: Education, economic development, Puerto Rican/Latino communities, arts & culture, youth programs, community empowerment
Documentation_Requirements__c:
Eligibility requirements:

• Registered nonprofit, tax-exempt 501(c)(3) charitable organization.
• Must provide meaningful volunteer opportunities for Popular employees.
• Must integrate a Popular employee liaison.
• Must economically empower individuals in the community.
• Must use non-traditional learning environments and provide programs directly in communities.
• Must demonstrate sustainability and program success.
• Must be nondiscriminatory.
• Proposal should show reasonable per-participant costs and request no more than 50% of funds for either general operating costs or staff salaries.
